evd_title: GPT-4o identified 52% coarse accuracy on LimitGen-Syn while human experts achieved 86% and MARG reached 68.1%
finding: GPT-4o identified 52% coarse accuracy on LimitGen-Syn while human experts achieved 86% and MARG reached 68.1%
P: LIMITGEN-Syn: 1,000 perturbed examples from 500 NLP arXiv papers (11 limitation subtypes)
I: GPT-4o zero-shot limitation generation (top-3); also GPT-4o-mini, Llama-3.3-70B, Qwen-2.5-72B
C: Human experts (2 annotators); MARG multi-agent (GPT-4o-mini agents); other LLMs
O: Coarse accuracy (GPT-4o judge): GPT-4o 52.0%, MARG 68.1%, human 86.0%; judge IAA kappa 0.833
